exact_rule: Serialize outer folds in order F1, F2, F3, F4.
Within an outer complement, serialize inner-validation folds in the exact outer_training_folds order recorded in c2_preflight_contract.json.
Within every validation fold, serialize query rows in the exact validation_ids sequence stored in artifacts/task1/evaluation/strict_cv_v2/folds.json.
Within one query, serialize multiple action rows by drop_rank descending and incoming_doc_id ascending by UTF-8 bytes.
Serialize JSON keys lexicographically with ensure_ascii=true, compact separators, UTF-8, and exactly one LF per JSONL object.
Concatenate pooled outer artifacts in F1, F2, F3, F4 order.

findings.detail: main() sends every --execute invocation to execute_is_not_authorized(), which raises for both PREFLIGHT_ONLY and every other authorization value. It never calls load_future_execution_data() or run_future_c2_execution(). The latter also requires label_loader and evaluator callbacks, but the canonical script supplies no concrete implementations. Consequently a separately authorized contract cannot execute the reviewed 32-fit lifecycle without another source change, so this SHA is not execution-ready.

The hidden --fit-worker entry point is dispatched before the --execute authorization gate. Its only approval is the literal stdin line APPROVE_FIT; it has no unforgeable parent/session token and does not require contract authorization. A caller can place a conforming job under the approved root, set the pinned environment, send APPROVE_FIT, and cause Task1 fitting while the contract remains PREFLIGHT_ONLY.

validate_worker_identity() checks only that pid is an integer; launch_fit_worker() never requires the reported PID to equal process.pid. The required parent-worker PID handshake is therefore reported but not validated.

load_future_execution_data() calls _read_jsonl_rows(actions_path), which json.loads() every complete action row, including Fold0 gain/label/features, and only then passes the resulting labelled dictionaries to structural_filter_f1_f4(). Fold0 is thus ignored after its scientific payload has already been decoded into in-memory structures, contrary to the mandated hard structural isolation boundary.

For C2-R margin selection, select_c2r_margin() validates a frozen label-free score artifact and then invokes label_loader/evaluator with that score artifact plus a mutable candidate margin. Candidate-specific selected-action and top5 bytes are not constructed, structurally validated, or SHA-frozen until after the winning margin has already been chosen using labels. This does not enforce the required score/action-bytes -> validate -> SHA freeze -> truth join lifecycle for each evaluated candidate.

C2RunBudget tracks only one aggregate fits_started counter and reserve_fit() receives no model family. The final check proves only 32 aggregate launches, not exactly 16 C2-V and 16 C2-R launches. Failed launch attempts consume the aggregate budget correctly, but the frozen per-family budget invariant is not fail-closed.
